title: 2030 — First classroom hulls networks graduate 100
definition: 2030 milestone on the Curiosity Engine Classrooms roadmap.
description:
First classroom hulls networks graduate 100,000 learners with inquiry cycles credentials employers trust.

What must be true first: the question banks results have to replicate outside the lab, classroom logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and inquiry cycles operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed question banks demonstrations, classroom logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting inquiry cycles uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Curiosity Engine Classrooms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Curiosity Engine Classrooms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Curiosity Engine Classrooms — classrooms driven by student questions.

Phase 1 — Prove (question banks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (classroom logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (inquiry cycles): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (teacher roles): classroom hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and schools-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
